title: Show hierarchical structure in list output
description:
Display issues with visual hierarchy when listing, showing epic relationships through indentation or tree structure:

Example:
  epic-a1b2 [epic] [TODO] Feature Development (3 issues)
    uc-c3d4   [uc] [TODO] ├─ User can do X
    bug-e5f6  [bug] [TODO] ├─ Fix related issue
    des-g7h8  [des] [DONE] └─ Design component

Benefits:
- Immediately see project structure
- Understand which issues are grouped
- Navigate from epic to children without separate commands
- More useful than flat list for projects with epics

Implementation: Add --tree or --hierarchical flag to 'pebbles list', or make default when epics exist.
